summary.en: Read and write UTF-8 text, close buffered resources and keep failed loads from corrupting state.
summary.bn: UTF-8 ফাইল পড়ো ও লেখো, রিসোর্স বন্ধ করো আর ফাইল পড়া ব্যর্থ হলে আগের ডেটা রাখো।

notes: Path.of and Files.readString/writeString need Java 11; programs use Java 17.

sections.title: Turn a path into text with a clear encoding
Choose a small-file or streaming operation
Follow characters through buffers and storage
Avoid guessing about paths and successful saves
Treat file access as a fallible boundary

examples.title: Round-trip Bangla and English text
examples.explanationHtml: The temporary file stores UTF-8 bytes. Reading reconstructs the original two lines.

examples.title: Write buffered lines and read a total
examples.explanationHtml: The writer closes before the reader opens. The read loop distinguishes EOF from content.

examples.title: Handle an absent file
examples.explanationHtml: The new directory contains no absent.txt file. The handler prints a stable useful message.

practice.title: Save marks then read their total
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..30) then n marks (0..100). Save one mark per line to a temporary UTF-8 file, read it back and print the total. Delete the temporary file. No prompt.

practice.title: Append a second word
practice.statementHtml: Read two ASCII word tokens. Write the first plus newline, append the second plus newline, and print the file contents. Use a temporary UTF-8 file and delete it. No prompt.
hints: Use APPEND only for the second write.

practice.title: Protect live records
practice.statementHtml: An inventory has ten valid books. Loading another file fails on its third row. What should the live inventory contain afterward?
practice.answerHtml: Keep the original ten books. Parse into temporary storage and replace only after every row validates. Explain the failed load to the user and preserve its diagnostic cause.
hints: A failed load is not a partial successful replacement.

practice.title: Explain a relative path
practice.statementHtml: Why can marks.txt work in an IDE but fail from another terminal directory?
practice.answerHtml: The path resolves against the current working directory. The IDE and terminal may use different directories. Configure the path or document the required working directory.
hints: Path resolution is unrelated to the source file location.

quiz.prompt: Which two lines survive the UTF-8 text round trip?
quiz.explanation: The explicit UTF-8 write and read preserve Bangla and the two newline separators.

quiz.prompt: What total is read through the buffered line loop?
quiz.explanation: readLine removes terminators; parsing adds ten and twenty.

quiz.prompt: What message appears when the deliberately absent file is opened?
quiz.explanation: IOException is handled at the operation boundary rather than treated as empty content.

quiz.prompt: What does readLine return at end of file?
quiz.explanation: An empty string is a valid blank line, while null signals EOF.

quiz.prompt: What does Path.of do by itself?
quiz.explanation: File access happens in subsequent operations.

quiz.prompt: What is the default effect of Files.writeString on an existing file?
quiz.explanation: Choose APPEND explicitly when that is the intended operation.

quiz.prompt: Why specify UTF-8 in a file format?
options: So bytes have a consistent text interpretation
quiz.explanation: Encoding controls character representation, not storage reliability.

quiz.prompt: Why load into a temporary collection first?
options: To preserve old state if any row is invalid
quiz.explanation: Commit validated data only after the full load succeeds.

quiz.prompt: Which resource policy fits a BufferedReader?
quiz.explanation: The reader must close on both success and failure.

quiz.prompt: Does flush guarantee survival after power loss?
quiz.explanation: Flushing a Java writer is not a full durable-storage guarantee.

keyPoints.en: A Path names a location without opening it.
keyPoints.bn: Path শুধু ফাইলের ঠিকানা বোঝায়, ফাইল খোলে না।

keyPoints.en: An explicit encoding makes text portable.
keyPoints.bn: এনকোডিং ঠিক করে দিলে অন্য কম্পিউটারেও টেক্সট ঠিকমতো পড়া যায়।

keyPoints.en: readLine returns null at end of file.
keyPoints.bn: ফাইলের শেষ হলে readLine null দেয়।

keyPoints.en: Close readers and writers on every exit path.
keyPoints.bn: কাজ সফল বা ব্যর্থ যাই হোক, রিডার আর রাইটার বন্ধ করো।

keyPoints.en: Validate a full load before replacing current data.
keyPoints.bn: সব ডেটা যাচাই করে তবেই আগের ডেটা বদলাও।

examQuestions.question: Compare Files.readString with BufferedReader.
examQuestions.answerHtml: readString loads the whole bounded text into memory. BufferedReader processes lines incrementally and must be closed. Both can use explicit UTF-8 and both can fail with IOException.

examQuestions.question: Explain safe replacement of an in-memory inventory after load.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Parse all rows into temporary records, reject invalid fields and duplicate ids, then replace the live collection only after the whole operation succeeds.

examQuestions.question: Why does a file writer need closure despite garbage collection?
examQuestions.answerHtml: The writer owns an external resource and may buffer data. Closing flushes and releases it promptly; object-memory reclamation is a separate concern.
